2131-2173-2981-4574--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2131-2173-2981-4574--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1719-2645-3430-3478.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3430-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2893-3875-6763-7941.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4875-5507-6871-6879.description:
Cast Inquisitive Puppet by paying {1}.
When Inquisitive Puppet enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, it and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Inquisitve Puppet trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Inquisitive Puppet as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Inquisitive Puppet by exiling it.
Toph triggers, returning Inquisitve Puppet from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Inquisitive Puppet ability from step 5, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

5686-6529-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

789-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6476-6927.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2034-4871-6476-6927.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Damage Control Crew and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers three times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1965-3394-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Weatherlight Compleated.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Omarthis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

1850-2573-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2573-5411.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1074-3755-4222.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

3497-4484-4871-5256-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5256-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5256-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3497-4484-4871-5256-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1424-1491-4050-6667.description:
Activate Loporrit Scout by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3705-4050-5997-6633.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

713-1657.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it and Surrak and Goreclaw trigger.
Resolve the Surrak and Goreclaw trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1922-2239.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1922-2239.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2608-3291-4499.notablePrerequisites: Karametra's Acolyte does not have summoning sickness. Your devotion to green is at least three.
2608-3291-4499.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.

1698-2292-2577-3260.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
1698-2292-2577-3260.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B} or 2 life due to K'rrik.
K'rrik triggers, as well as each creature you control's extort ability.
Resolve the first K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay {W/B} or 2 life due to K'rrik, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

1770-3089-4659-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks five times by sacrificing five Myrs, adding ten {C}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing a Myr, returning Myr Battlesphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1311-3341-4481.notablePrerequisites:
Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness.
Heavy Arbalest attached to Charnelhoard Wurm.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}.

Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}.
Activate Charnelhoard Wurm by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Mobilize to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Mobilize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}, this combo will net infinite mana.

654-1168-1651-3318-5077.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Scaretiller and another artifact, targeting Scaretiller.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Fabled Passage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Fabled Passage enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Fabled Passage.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability from step 1, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Fabled Passage by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search your library for a basic land, put it onto the battlefield tapped, and untap the land if you control four or more lands.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Toggo triggers, creating a Rock equipment token.
Repeat.

1124-1651-3836-4659-5002.notablePrerequisites: Urza, Lord Protector and The Mightstone and Weakstone melded into Urza, Planeswalker.
1124-1651-3836-4659-5002.description:
Activate Urza, Planeswalker's third loyalty ability by putting no loyalty counters on it, creating two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Soldiers, untapping The Chain Veil.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archghoul of Thraben, adding {C}{C}.
Mortuary and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Archghoul of Thraben on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Archghoul of Thraben from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Cast Archghoul of Thraben by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Necrosynthesis attached to Herd Baloth.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
1628-2034-3197.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

776-1237-1329-2709.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.

Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Fountain of Youth to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Fountain of Youth.
Cast Fountain of Youth.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

539-1247-1682.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-1682.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
